connection: Connection details, credentials, tags and categories.
storage: Local capacity and temporary download placement.
scanner: Workers, timeouts and protected advanced scan limits.
deployment: Protected paths and policies. Change these in Portainer or the local file while Intake is stopped.

default_change_hint: Saved in /app/data/settings.json. An explicit environment value from Compose or Portainer wins and is saved locally at startup. File/UI changes require a container restart.

specs.name: app_name
specs.label: Legacy application name
specs.description: Accepted for compatibility with old settings files only; it has no effect. Use UI title to change the page heading.
specs.change_hint: Legacy compatibility value, not an active setting. There is no need to define TI_APP_NAME.

specs.name: debug
specs.label: Debug logging
specs.description: Enables verbose application logging. Leave disabled for normal operation.

specs.name: data_dir
specs.label: Local application data directory
specs.description: Bootstrap container directory containing SQLite, settings, and restore state. Keep its host mount on local SSD storage. Only TI_DATA_DIR in the container environment can relocate it.

specs.name: database_url
specs.label: Database location
specs.description: SQLite database containing jobs, checkpoints, migrations and scanner controls. Only a SQLite file inside TI_DATA_DIR is supported; other database engines are not available.

specs.name: ui_title
specs.label: UI title
specs.description: Heading displayed at the top of the Torrent Intake interface.

specs.name: qbt_host
specs.label: qBittorrent API URL
specs.description: Private Web API endpoint reachable from Torrent Intake, for example http://qbittorrent:8080 on a shared Docker network. This is separate from the URL you open in your browser.

specs.name: qbt_username
specs.label: qBittorrent username
specs.description: Account name used for authenticated qBittorrent API calls.

specs.name: qbt_password
specs.label: qBittorrent password
specs.description: Password used for qBittorrent API authentication. The value is never returned to the UI.

specs.name: qbt_verify_certificate
specs.label: Verify qBittorrent TLS certificate
specs.description: Validates the qBittorrent HTTPS certificate when TLS is used.

value_explanations.Disabled: TLS certificate validation is disabled; use only on a trusted private path.

specs.name: qbt_request_timeout_seconds
specs.label: qBittorrent request timeout
specs.description: Maximum wait for an individual qBittorrent API request, in seconds.

specs.name: qbt_web_url
specs.label: Browser qBittorrent URL
specs.description: Browser-safe link shown in the UI. This can differ from the private API URL used by the container.

specs.name: intake_category
specs.label: Intake category
specs.description: qBittorrent category assigned while a torrent is managed by Intake.

specs.name: managed_tag
specs.label: Managed tag
specs.description: Required qBittorrent tag proving that a torrent remains under Torrent Intake control.

specs.name: auto_create_final_category
specs.label: Create final categories
specs.description: Allows Torrent Intake to create a requested final qBittorrent category when it does not already exist.

specs.name: completion_event_token
specs.label: Completion-hook token
specs.description: Authenticates qBittorrent completion callbacks. The value is never returned to the UI.

specs.name: local_staging_root
specs.label: Local staging root
specs.description: Exact container path used for locally staged torrents. qBittorrent must see the same content at the same path.

specs.name: nas_staging_root
specs.label: NAS staging root
specs.description: Legacy single NAS path, used only while the named NAS list is empty. Existing job choices stay pinned. qBittorrent must see identical container paths.

specs.name: nas_staging_locations
specs.label: NAS staging locations
specs.description: Named temporary download locations mounted at the same paths in Intake and qBittorrent. A marker is an existing file on the NAS (absolute container path); Intake never creates it. Existing job paths cannot be removed while in use.

specs.name: default_nas_staging_id
specs.label: Automatic NAS default
specs.description: Exactly one named NAS used for new jobs and local overflow. Existing jobs retain their saved fallback. This does not select the final library destination.

specs.name: post_promotion_enabled
specs.label: Run script after promotion
specs.description: Run the deployment-configured trusted script only after clean scanning, completed final promotion, delay and revalidation. No scripts are queued for historical completed jobs. Scripts have Intake's permissions, not a separate sandbox.

specs.name: post_promotion_copy_enabled
specs.label: Copy after successful promotion
specs.description: Enable one-time copies for newly promoted torrents whose final parent matches an enabled copy rule. No match means no copy. Originals are retained and collisions are protected. Choose built-in copying OR a custom script; neither is a continuous folder sync.

specs.name: post_promotion_copy_rules
specs.label: Copy destination rules
specs.description: Map final-library source roots to existing destinations under /copy-target. The most specific enabled source containing the job's final parent wins; unmatched jobs are not copied. Disabled rules are ignored, so a broader enabled rule can still match. Relative folders are preserved, without a per-job wrapper. Queued jobs retain their saved rule. Maximum 32 rules.

specs.name: post_promotion_copy_destination
specs.label: Legacy copy destination (compatibility only)
specs.description: Retained for older settings and backups. This global destination is ignored for newly promoted jobs: configure Copy destination rules instead. Previously queued copies keep their pinned destination and layout.
specs.change_hint: Do not configure this for new copies. Add explicit source-to-destination rules in Downloads and storage instead.

specs.name: post_promotion_script
specs.label: Trusted post-promotion script
specs.description: Absolute executable path under /hooks, mounted read-only. Configure in Portainer or settings.json while stopped. Script files are NOT included in portable backups. Never point this at downloaded content.

specs.name: post_promotion_delay_seconds
specs.label: Post-promotion buffer
specs.description: Minimum delay after verified promotion before checking again and copying or running the script; not a substitute for move verification.

specs.name: post_promotion_timeout_seconds
specs.label: Post-promotion action timeout
specs.description: Maximum copy or script runtime, followed by a short shutdown grace period. A timeout does not rescan or move the promoted torrent again. Inspect partial copies before retrying.

specs.name: final_parent_prefix
specs.label: Primary final root
specs.description: Primary canonical media boundary allowed for clean promotion destinations.

specs.name: final_parent_prefixes
specs.label: Additional final roots
specs.description: Optional comma-separated canonical media boundaries allowed in addition to the primary final root.

specs.name: local_overflow_policy
specs.label: Local overflow policy
specs.description: Action taken when aggregate local staging capacity is unavailable for another torrent.

value_explanations.queue: Wait for local capacity while preserving the requested local staging preference.
value_explanations.nas: Switch eligible work to temporary NAS intake staging when local capacity is unavailable; the chosen final destination does not change.

specs.name: local_max_gib
specs.label: Maximum local torrent size
specs.description: A torrent larger than this GiB limit is directed to NAS staging instead of local staging.

specs.name: local_free_space_buffer_gib
specs.label: Local free-space reserve
specs.description: GiB kept unused when Torrent Intake calculates safe local staging capacity.

specs.name: polling_interval_seconds
specs.label: Recovery polling interval
specs.description: How often the background reconciliation pass checks qBittorrent when no completion callback arrives.

specs.name: completion_grace_seconds
specs.label: Completion grace period
specs.description: Delay after a completion signal before Torrent Intake begins its final completion and pause checks.

specs.name: scanner_backend
specs.label: Scanner backend
specs.description: Compatibility selector: only clamd is supported. It may be omitted; there is no clamscan or alternate backend.

specs.name: clamd_socket_path
specs.label: ClamD socket
specs.description: Private Unix socket shared only with the Torrent Intake ClamD sidecar.

specs.name: scanner_policy_version
specs.label: Scanner policy version
specs.description: Identity of the scan policy stored with checkpoints. Changing it invalidates incompatible clean checkpoints.

specs.name: scanner_max_file_mib
specs.label: Native ClamD stream boundary
specs.description: Raw-size boundary for one native ClamD stream. Larger RAR/ZIP archives use member extraction; verified video and raw TrueHD use bounded windows. Eligible native size-limit failures use the same routes.

specs.name: scanner_health_cache_seconds
specs.label: Scanner health cache
specs.description: How long a successful ClamD health result may be reused, in seconds.

specs.name: scanner_connect_timeout_seconds
specs.label: ClamD connection timeout
specs.description: Maximum time to establish a private socket connection, in seconds.

specs.name: scanner_scan_timeout_seconds
specs.label: Per-file scan timeout
specs.description: Maximum total client wait for one streamed file scan, in seconds.

specs.name: scanner_definitions_warn_hours
specs.label: Definition warning age
specs.description: Definition age in hours at which the UI and events begin warning before scans are blocked.

specs.name: scanner_definitions_stale_hours
specs.label: Definition stale age
specs.description: Definition age in hours at which scanning fails closed until current definitions are available.

specs.name: large_media_enabled
specs.label: Large-media scanner
specs.description: Routes oversized verified videos and narrowly validated raw TrueHD audio, plus eligible media whose native scan reaches a parser/expanded-data limit, through full-byte overlapping ClamD windows.

specs.name: large_media_max_file_gib
specs.label: Maximum large-media size
specs.description: Hard GiB ceiling for the bounded large-media path. Larger individual files remain held without a clean verdict.

specs.name: large_media_chunk_mib
specs.label: Large-media ClamD window
specs.description: MiB sent in each independent ClamD window. It must remain below the native ClamD stream limit.

specs.name: large_media_min_chunk_mib
specs.label: Minimum adaptive media window
specs.description: Smallest MiB window allowed for a raw stream/file size limit. Expansion, recursion, and unknown limits within a window remain blocked instead of being subdivided.

specs.name: large_media_overlap_kib
specs.label: Large-media window overlap
specs.description: KiB repeated between neighboring windows to preserve short byte signatures at boundaries; this cannot preserve every signature or container parser context.

specs.name: large_media_probe_timeout_seconds
specs.label: Media validation timeout
specs.description: Maximum time allowed for ffprobe to verify the real container and stream layout of an oversized file.

specs.name: large_media_scan_timeout_seconds
specs.label: Large-media scan timeout
specs.description: Total deadline for validating and reading every window of one oversized media file.

specs.name: ffprobe_binary
specs.label: ffprobe executable
specs.description: Image-provided ffprobe path used to validate oversized media. The Docker image installs it at build time.

specs.name: ffmpeg_binary
specs.label: ffmpeg executable
specs.description: Image-provided tool for bounded attachment extraction. It does not transcode media files or unpack torrent archives.

specs.name: media_attachment_max_mib
specs.label: Maximum attachment size
specs.description: MiB allowed for one extracted attachment, between 1 and 64. Each attachment must complete a native ClamD scan; it is never chunked or skipped.

specs.name: media_attachment_total_mib
specs.label: Total attachment budget
specs.description: Maximum MiB extracted from one media file, at most 256. Cover images reserve their per-attachment maximum because their size is unknown before extraction.

specs.name: archive_enabled
specs.label: Archive member scanning
specs.description: Inspect oversized RAR/ZIP archives and eligible native size-limit failures using temporary extracted copies. Original archives and torrent folders are preserved.

specs.name: archive_scratch_dir
specs.label: Archive scratch storage
specs.description: Existing container directory on local or NAS storage. Intake uses a private archive-scan subdirectory. Leave blank to use TI_DATA_DIR. Configure the matching writable Docker mount first; unavailable custom storage never falls back to the data disk.

specs.name: archive_scratch_mount_marker
specs.label: Archive scratch mount marker
specs.description: Optional absolute path to an existing readable marker file inside custom scratch storage. A missing marker blocks archive inspection; Intake never creates it. Leave blank to disable the marker check.

specs.name: archive_max_file_gib
specs.label: Maximum archive size
specs.description: Maximum GiB for a source RAR/ZIP archive admitted to member scanning.

specs.name: archive_max_expanded_gib
specs.label: Archive extraction budget
specs.description: Maximum total GiB extracted per archive, including nested archive copies. Scratch files use the selected scratch filesystem and are removed after inspection.

specs.name: archive_max_files
specs.label: Maximum archive entries
specs.description: Total entries, including directories and nested archives, admitted during one archive inspection.

specs.name: archive_max_depth
specs.label: Maximum archive nesting
specs.description: Maximum RAR/ZIP nesting levels sharing the extraction budget; the outer archive is level one.

specs.name: archive_scan_timeout_seconds
specs.label: Archive inspection timeout
specs.description: Total seconds allowed for extraction and all member scans of one archive.

specs.name: archive_free_space_buffer_gib
specs.label: Archive scratch free-space reserve
specs.description: GiB kept free on the selected scratch filesystem while temporary members are extracted.

specs.name: per_job_scan_workers
specs.label: Large-file workers per torrent
specs.description: Maximum large-media byte ranges from one torrent that may be streamed to ClamD simultaneously.

specs.name: clamd_max_inflight_requests
specs.label: Global ClamD request limit
specs.description: Hard application-wide limit for simultaneous ClamD INSTREAM requests across every active torrent. Keep it at or below ClamD MaxThreads.

specs.name: max_concurrent_scans
specs.label: Default concurrent scans
specs.description: Default torrent scan slots for a new queue and after a temporary boost ends. Existing slot requests are saved in SQLite.
specs.change_hint: Use the Scan Queue slot control for live adjustments. Edit this field, the local file or an environment override for the default, then restart; a saved queue request is not automatically reset by restarting.

specs.name: max_scan_slots
specs.label: Hard scan-slot ceiling
specs.description: Maximum slot count the runtime Scan Queue control is permitted to request.

specs.name: max_concurrent_large_scans
specs.label: Concurrent large scans
specs.description: Maximum number of torrents above the large-job threshold that can scan at the same time.

specs.name: large_scan_gib
specs.label: Large-job threshold
specs.description: Torrent size in GiB at which the separate large-scan concurrency bound applies.

specs.name: scan_scheduler_interval_seconds
specs.label: Scan scheduler interval
specs.description: Delay between scheduler attempts to claim pending scan work, in seconds.

specs.name: scan_lease_seconds
specs.label: Scan lease duration
specs.description: Restart-recovery lease protecting an actively owned scan, in seconds.

specs.name: scan_heartbeat_seconds
specs.label: Scan heartbeat interval
specs.description: How frequently an active worker refreshes its durable scan lease, in seconds.

specs.name: scan_retry_base_seconds
specs.label: Scan retry base delay
specs.description: Initial delay used by exponential retry after scanner failures, in seconds.

specs.name: scan_max_failures
specs.label: Maximum scan failures
specs.description: Failure count after which a file/job requires explicit operator retry.

specs.name: scan_yield_after_files
specs.label: Files before scheduler yield
specs.description: Number of successfully checkpointed files processed before a worker yields so other queued jobs can progress.

specs.name: pause_confirmation_timeout_seconds
specs.label: Pause confirmation timeout
specs.description: Maximum wait for qBittorrent to confirm a torrent is paused before scanning or a destructive action.

specs.name: infected_action
specs.label: Infected-content action
specs.description: Action after a verified malware detection. This safety-critical value cannot be changed from the UI.

value_explanations.hold: Leave the torrent paused in its verified staging location. This is the built-in safe default.
value_explanations.quarantine: Ask qBittorrent to move the torrent into an exclusive quarantine directory; both containers need the same /quarantine mount.
value_explanations.delete: After repeating all safety checks, ask qBittorrent to remove the torrent and delete its data, then verify removal.

specs.name: quarantine_root
specs.label: Torrent quarantine root
specs.description: Canonical quarantine boundary used only when the infected-content action is quarantine.

specs.name: event_dir
specs.label: Structured event directory
specs.description: Writable spool where Torrent Intake atomically emits notifier events. It must be persistent.
